title: Google unveils Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Spark agent, and Gemini Omni at I/O 2026
summary: Google announced Gemini 3.5 Flash as the new default Gemini model, Gemini Spark (24/7 personal AI agent), and Gemini Omni for video generation at Google I/O 2026.

title: NVIDIA delivers Vera CPU to Anthropic, OpenAI, Oracle, and SpaceXAI
summary: NVIDIA's first CPU built for agentic AI delivery to top AI labs, delivering 2x efficiency and 50% faster performance than traditional rack-scale CPUs.

title: xAI launches Grok Build early beta for terminal-based coding agents
summary: xAI releases Grok Build, its first AI coding agent positioned against Anthropic's Claude Code. Available in early beta to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers.

title: MiniMax launches Mavis with adversarial multi-agent team mode
summary: MiniMax launches Mavis featuring adversarial multi-agent teams with Leader, Worker, and Verifier roles for continuous task improvement.

title: Anthropic launches Claude for Small Business with connectors for QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot
summary: Claude for Small Business launches with connectors to QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. Includes 15 agentic workflows.

title: NVIDIA Hermes unlocks self-improving AI agents powered by Qwen 3.6 on RTX PCs
summary: NVIDIA Hermes launches as a self-improving AI agent running on local RTX PCs and DGX Spark, powered by Qwen 3.6 models.

title: NVIDIA and SAP bring trust to specialized agents with OpenShell integration
summary: NVIDIA and SAP expand collaboration to help enterprises run specialized agents with security and governance controls through OpenShell open-source runtime.

title: Anthropic Claude Platform on AWS now generally available
summary: Claude Platform on AWS launches in GA, giving AWS customers direct access to Anthropic's native Claude Platform experience including Managed Agents, web search, code execution, and Skills.

title: Alibaba integrates Qwen AI with Taobao for agentic shopping experience
summary: Alibaba fully integrates Qwen AI with Taobao's 4+ billion product catalog enabling conversational shopping with AI virtual try-on, 30-day price tracking, and one-tap checkout.

title: MiniMax launches Realtime API for multimodal voice interactions
summary: MiniMax releases Realtime API with HTTP and WebSocket interfaces for end-to-end real-time multimodal processing with ultra-low latency and hyper-personalized voice library.

title: NVIDIA releases SANA-WM open-source world model for video generation
summary: NVIDIA open-sources SANA-WM, a 2.6B-parameter world model that generates minute-scale 720p video on a single RTX 5090 GPU.

title: NVIDIA Fleet Intelligence now generally available for GPU fleet monitoring
summary: NVIDIA Fleet Intelligence launches GA — an agent-based managed service for real-time monitoring of GPU fleets across Blackwell, Vera Rubin, and Hopper architectures.

title: OpenAI model proves 1946 geometry conjecture false
summary: OpenAI's latest model successfully disproved a 70-year-old geometry conjecture, marking a significant milestone in AI-driven mathematical research.

title: xAI Grok Build coding agent early beta now available
summary: xAI releases Grok Build, a command-line coding agent in early beta for SuperGrok subscribers, positioned as a competitor to Anthropic's Claude Code.

title: DeepSeek makes 75% discount on V4-Pro permanent
summary: DeepSeek announces permanent 75% discount on V4-Pro model, making advanced AI significantly more accessible for developers and enterprises.

title: Mistral Large 3 outperforms GPT-5 on French language benchmarks
summary: Mistral Large 3 achieves state-of-the-art results on French language benchmarks, outperforming GPT-5 on FLAMME, FrenchMMLU, and other法语 evaluation sets.

title: Anthropic launches MCP Tunnels for enterprise secure connections
summary: Anthropic releases MCP Tunnels, enabling enterprises to securely connect Claude to internal infrastructure without data leaving their network.

title: Meta announces 8000 layoffs, 7000 roles shifted to AI teams
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announces restructuring with 8000 job cuts while redirecting 7000 positions to AI-focused roles as part of the 'Year of the Agent' initiative.

title: NVIDIA reports record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B
summary: NVIDIA shatters expectations with $81.6B revenue in Q1 FY2027, up 120% year-over-year, driven by massive demand for Blackwell GPUs and data center expansion.

title: Alibaba releases Qwen3.7-Max with 35-hour autonomous execution
summary: Alibaba's Qwen3.7-Max debuts with breakthrough 35-hour autonomous execution capability, enabling AI agents to operate independently for extended periods without human intervention.

title: Anthropic acquires Stainless to expand agent connectivity
summary: Anthropic acquires Stainless, a leader in SDKs and MCP server tooling, to extend Claude's ability to connect to data and tools.

title: Anthropic forms $200M partnership with Gates Foundation
summary: Anthropic partners with Gates Foundation to commit $200M in grant funding and Claude credits for global health, education, and economic mobility programs.
